title: Document Buildkite adapter compatibility and preserve GitHub Actions workflows
intent: Keep .github/workflows/*.yml as the canonical CI and release contract, execute it through the Buildkite github-actions adapter, record the passing and failing paths from the v0.102.2 post-release evidence, and prepare a precise escalation packet for Buildkite engineering without introducing a second native workflow source.
proof_hooks: native Buildkite YAML structural and changed-path gate validation
published PR checks and master-merge failure classification
stop_conditions: Do not merge a native Buildkite rewrite or disable workflow gates until Buildkite engineering has diagnosed the adapter failures and the adapter-backed required checks are green.
deferred_questions: After adapter parity is proven across PR, master, release, docs, and tag-publication paths, decide when to disable the GitHub Actions service.
